queries.description: CTE with literal selection and filter
queries.sql: WITH CTE_1 AS (SELECT 'a' AS val FROM {mytable} GROUP BY val) SELECT 1 FROM CTE_1 WHERE val >= 'a' AND val < 'b'

queries.description: CTE with search + OR filter on constants
queries.sql: WITH CTE_1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN strCol = 'foo' THEN 'A' ELSE strCol END AS cased FROM {mytable}) SELECT 1 FROM CTE_1 WHERE ((cased = 'B') OR (cased = 'A'))

queries.description: Literal SEARCH filter on subquery with CASE WHEN
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN strCol = 'foo' THEN 'a' ELSE 'b' END AS val FROM {mytable}) WHERE val IN ('a', 'b')

literal_function_evaluation.comments: The planner evaluates a function call on literals. It must pass the literals as the Java values that the runtime passes for the same values, e.g. an Integer for an INT literal rather than the BigDecimal that Calcite stores, or functions that dispatch on the value class return other results. Each query compares a call on a literal with the same call on column values, which runs above the leaf stage because of the GROUP BY.

queries.sql: SELECT intCol, toBase64(toThetaSketch(5)) = toBase64(toThetaSketch(intCol)), toBase64(toHLL(5)) = toBase64(toHLL(intCol)), toBase64(toCpcSketch(5)) = toBase64(toCpcSketch(intCol)), toBase64(toULL(5)) = toBase64(toULL(intCol)), toBase64(toIntegerSumTupleSketch(5, 1)) = toBase64(toIntegerSumTupleSketch(intCol, 1)) FROM (SELECT intCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY intCol) t
queries.h2Sql: SELECT intCol, intCol = 5, intCol = 5, intCol = 5, intCol = 5, intCol = 5 FROM (SELECT intCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY intCol) t

queries.sql: SELECT longCol, toBase64(toThetaSketch(10000000005)) = toBase64(toThetaSketch(longCol)) FROM (SELECT longCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY longCol) t
queries.h2Sql: SELECT longCol, longCol = 10000000005 FROM (SELECT longCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY longCol) t

queries.description: Sketch of a DECIMAL literal, which the runtime reads as a DOUBLE
queries.sql: SELECT doubleCol, toBase64(toThetaSketch(1.5)) = toBase64(toThetaSketch(doubleCol)) FROM (SELECT doubleCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY doubleCol) t
queries.h2Sql: SELECT doubleCol, doubleCol = 1.5 FROM (SELECT doubleCol FROM {tbl} GROUP BY doubleCol) t
